description: One line of a packer's settlement: this much of this variety at this grade, packed, at this price. Packed weight times price per unit is the gross amount, which the controller fills in where the statement did not — and leaves alone where it did, because a packer who applied a promotion to a line is telling the truth and the multiplication is not.

fields.description: What packed out on this line, in the statement's weight unit.
fields.label: Packed Weight

fields.description: The unit the price is quoted per, which is not always the unit the weight is in — a packer quotes per box and weighs in pounds often enough that assuming they agree would misprice a line by a factor of forty.
fields.label: Price UOM

fields.description: Packed weight times price per unit, unless the statement says otherwise.
fields.label: Gross Amount

name: Settlement Line Item
